'''Zon''' was a male [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] miner living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3631 BBY]] he was part of the mining group working on Ilum for the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]], who secured the mining rights from both Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After the miners accidentally desecrated the burial site of [[Xivhkalrainik's father]], his son, the Sith Lord [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]], began attacking their mining camps, slaughtering everyone. When Zon lost contact with [[Shaft 12]], help arrived in form of [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance commander]], who set to track down the murderer. Xalek eventually attacked [[Cross-Shelf Corridor|Zon's mining camp]], but was stopped by the Alliance Commander before he could kill Zon and his foreman.

==Behind the scenes==
Zon appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Xalek Alliance alert mission.
